pixelmondetector.config.allowRightClickI: Whether to allow right click to show Pokemon details like how Ras's lens do when hands are empty
pixelmondetector.config.allowPokemonKeyI: Whether to allow searching for Pokemon key information(abilities, ivs and nature)
pixelmondetector.config.allowDexTracking: Whether to allow searching for Pokemons that haven't been recorded in players' Pokedex
pixelmondetector.config.pokeLootFilter.t: Listed Poke Loots will be tracked. Feel free to remove if you don't want to track one or more, leave it empty to disable Poke loot tracking
pixelmondetector.config.bossFilter.toolt: Listed Bosses will be tracked. Feel free to remove if you don't want to track one or more, leave it empty to disable Boss tracking
pixelmondetector.config.drawPlayerPokemo: Whether to draw players' pokemon markers/lines
The scale of markers' font size
pixelmondetector.config.drawThings.toolt: Whether to draw lines/markers/infos (master switch). Must be exactly 3 boolean values in this list, the same below
pixelmondetector.config.drawBosses.toolt: Determines if lines/markers/infos should be drawn for Bosses
Determines if lines/markers/infos should be drawn for Legendaries
Determines if lines/markers/infos should be drawn for Ultra Beasts
pixelmondetector.config.drawParadoxes.to: Determines if lines/markers/infos should be drawn for Paradox Pokemons
pixelmondetector.config.drawShinies.tool: Determines if lines/markers/infos should be drawn for Shiny Pokemons
pixelmondetector.config.drawSearchedPkms: Determines if lines/markers/infos should be drawn for Searched Pokemons
Determines if lines/markers/infos should be drawn for Special Pokemons
pixelmondetector.config.drawOtherPlayers: Determines if lines/markers/infos should be drawn for other players
pixelmondetector.config.drawNPCs.tooltip: Determines if lines/markers/infos should be drawn for NPCs
pixelmondetector.config.drawWormholes.to: Determines if lines/markers/infos should be drawn for Ultra Wormholes
pixelmondetector.config.drawDens.tooltip: Determines if lines/markers/infos should be drawn for Dens
pixelmondetector.config.drawLoots.toolti: Determines if lines/markers/infos should be drawn for Poke Loots
pixelmondetector.config.drawPokestops.to: Determines if lines/markers/infos should be drawn for Poke Stops
pixelmondetector.config.drawShrines.tool: Determines if lines/markers/infos should be drawn for Shrines
pixelmondetector.config.drawZygardeCells: Determines if lines/markers/infos should be drawn for Zygarde Cells and Cores
